title: Fauxter asks for a reunion

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Heyyyyyy! I was just thinkin' about you. I got an IDEA! It's a good one. Guess what it is!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heyyyyyy! I was just thinkin' about you. I got an IDEA! It's a good one. Guess what it is!
Uh, no. That's not it.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: We're puttin' the band back together!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're puttin' the band back together!
It's a great idea, huh?

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: It's gonna work. It HAS to. Just say you'll help. I need you bud!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's gonna work. It HAS to. Just say you'll help. I need you bud!

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I'll tell you who you need to talk to. All you have to do is convince them that they should come back to the band.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you who you need to talk to. All you have to do is convince them that they should come back to the band.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Yeah... it might not be that easy. I mean, some of these folks really hate each other now. And they ALL hate me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... it might not be that easy. I mean, some of these folks really hate each other now. And they ALL hate me.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I mean you can probably guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean you can probably guess.
Yes. Obviously yes.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Well... I'm not exactly sure, where they are, but I know their names. I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I'm not exactly sure, where they are, but I know their names. I think.
That's right! I mean kinda.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Can't you just find our first album, and.. I dunno... GET THOSE FUNKY NAMES FROM THAT FUNKY SLEEVE?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't you just find our first album, and.. I dunno... GET THOSE FUNKY NAMES FROM THAT FUNKY SLEEVE?!
Wait! I can.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have the names and last known locations of Fauxter's bandmates. They are all fairly... infamous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have the names and last known locations of Fauxter's bandmates. They are all fairly... infamous.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Indeed. That part is simple enough. I suspect getting them to rejoin the band will be... substantially tougher.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. That part is simple enough. I suspect getting them to rejoin the band will be... substantially tougher.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: What's that Bud? You went awful quiet there. Are you on shrooms too? You can really lose days to... THE FUNGI!!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that Bud? You went awful quiet there. Are you on shrooms too? You can really lose days to... THE FUNGI!!

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Alright, well I'm countin' on ya bud! Get that band back together and you'll get to hear us play. I promise, it will be worth it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, well I'm countin' on ya bud! Get that band back together and you'll get to hear us play. I promise, it will be worth it!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I've added Fauxter's bandmates to your Comm, and added Nav Points for each. Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've added Fauxter's bandmates to your Comm, and added Nav Points for each. Good luck!

nodes.text: You need my help with some inane task?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: You need my help with some inane task?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You need my help with some inane task?

Right...
Sure, it could work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's a great idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure that's a great idea.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure that's a great idea.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure that's a great idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll help.
I can do that.

nodes.text: How am I supposed to do that?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: How am I supposed to do that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How am I supposed to do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
Did you cheat on someone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So who are these band members?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So who are these band members?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So who are these band members?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So who are these band members?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want to come work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want to come work for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want to come work for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want to come work for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to help put your band back together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to help put your band back together.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to help put your band back together.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to help put your band back together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You... think we would make a cute couple?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You... think we would make a cute couple?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You... think we would make a cute couple?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you try to go solo and steal all the glory?

nodes.text: You can help me find them?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can help me find them?
